name: obsidian-sample-plugin
description: This is a sample plugin for Obsidian (https://obsidian.md)

scripts.build: echo '🔧 Running TypeScript check...' && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && echo '📦 Building with esbuild...' && node esbuild.config.mjs production && echo '📄 Copying styles...' && cp src/styles.css styles.css && echo '✅ Build completed!'
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
